# lv2 kernel: kernel objects, PPU threads, the syscall dispatcher, memory, time, filesystem (plan section 8).
# The iOS app compiles every source in src/ (D-014), so src/ holds runtime code only; the syscall name table is
# a committed include generated by scripts/gen_syscall_table.py from recomp/common/data/syscalls.txt.
add_library(pspocket_lv2 STATIC
    src/event.cpp
    src/fs.cpp
    src/kernel.cpp
    src/lw.cpp
    src/memory.cpp
    src/process.cpp
    src/report.cpp
    src/rsx.cpp
    src/spu.cpp
    src/sync.cpp
    src/thread.cpp
    src/time.cpp
    src/vm.cpp)
target_include_directories(pspocket_lv2 PUBLIC include PRIVATE src)
target_link_libraries(pspocket_lv2 PUBLIC pspocket::core pspocket::ppu pspocket::rsx)
pspocket_set_warnings(pspocket_lv2)
add_library(pspocket::lv2 ALIAS pspocket_lv2)
